status: DRAFT - not frozen yet; freeze = commit this file with status FROZEN before the test run

mismatch.designs: LMMSE for assumed SNR a: main.baselines_run loading for a; SNR-aware MLPs get a; mlp_blind ignores it

joint.gmm_config: per seed and row, the (K, alpha) that seed chose on validation; refit must reproduce model_sha256

primary.M1: 64-subcarrier line: for each MLP variant (seed average) in each of 3 densities x 7 SNRs, the paired gain over LMMSE. 'No learned estimator beats LMMSE' holds if no cell has ci_excludes_zero = +1 together with a gain of at least equivalence_margin_db
primary.J1: joint setting: the GMM's (seed average) gain over joint LMMSE has ci_excludes_zero = +1 in every one of the 8 rows (2 patterns x 4 SNRs)
primary.J2: joint setting: the GMM's gain over each joint MLP (seed averages) has ci_excludes_zero = +1, reported per row; 'in every row' is claimed only if all 16 hold

claims.margin_rule: a gain whose CI lies inside [-0.1, +0.1] dB is called equal to LMMSE; a CI that excludes 0 by less than 0.1 dB is reported but called practically negligible
claims.ci_family: seed averages (@mean) carry the claims; per-seed results are descriptive
claims.multiplicity: counts of CIs that exclude zero are descriptive and not adjusted for multiplicity
claims.block_robustness: if ci95_200snap and ci95 disagree on a primary claim, the report gives both
descriptive_only: SNR-mismatch losses (offsets, worst case, fixed design)

validation_only.space32 GMM (experiment 06): 32-antenna denoising; not part of the report's comparison
validation_only.position genie (experiment 03): uses the true position; a diagnostic, not a receiver
